annotations.title: See who answered the RSVP (hosts and co-hosts)

description: THE HOSTS' OWN LIST of who answered the RSVP on a personal event this connector serves; call it for "who is coming", "who said maybe", "who has not answered". It returns the counts first (yes, maybe, no, not yet, and the headcount, which is each yes plus the guests it brings), then the first names under each answer, with "+N" beside a yes that brings guests, at most 40 names per answer and then a count of the rest. Only a host or a co-host can read it; anybody else gets a refusal you read out as given. A name is the name on the host's guest list or the first name a signed-in guest gave Sonar Connections, and there is no phone number, email or account id on this surface, so never offer to contact someone from this list; it only reads and requires a personal connector token.

eventIdOrName.description: The event id or the event NAME as the hosts spell it.
